name: linux-token-efficiency
description: Bundles the rtk token-optimizing CLI proxy (https://github.com/rtk-ai/rtk) as a Linux x86_64 binary and routes Bash commands through it via a PreToolUse rewrite hook, ships codebase-memory-mcp (https://github.com/DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp) as a plugin-local proxy MCP server that downloads and sha256-verifies the pinned release on first start with four context-only graph hooks, and registers the external context-mode package (https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode) as the context-mode MCP stdio server through a bun-preferred bunx / npx --yes launcher, injecting upstream's own routing-rules document verbatim at every session start via a SessionStart cat hook. LINUX ONLY: the bundled binaries are Linux executables, so on macOS, Windows or any other operating system this plugin does not work for the rtk and codebase-memory features, whose hooks no-op.

auto_rewrite.title: Auto-rewrite Bash commands through rtk
auto_rewrite.description: Before every Bash tool call, rewrites the command through the bundled rtk binary (rtk hook claude) so it runs token-optimized. Disabled, the bundled rtk stays on PATH and can still be invoked manually. Linux only — a no-op on every other OS. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it. Default: true.

cbm_enabled.title: Enable the codebase-memory-mcp MCP server and its context hooks
cbm_enabled.description: Runs codebase-memory-mcp (cbm) as the codebase-memory MCP stdio server through a plugin-local Node proxy, and enables the four context-only cbm graph hooks (SessionStart, SubagentStart, Grep/Glob, post-Read). On first start the proxy DOWNLOADS the pinned ~37.6 MiB release asset from GitHub Releases into the plugin's data directory and sha256-verifies it against the committed pin before extracting its ~280 MiB binary; one bounded attempt per server process, no repo mutation, and silence on failure. Linux x86_64 only. Set to false to disable: only the literal value false disables it; unset, missing or any other value leaves it enabled, and nothing is downloaded while disabled. Default: true. Disabling after first use does not delete the download cache; remove it by hand (see README).
